summary: Iteration 27: frontend-only retest of the offline Playgama build at /pgtest/index.html (build 13:59, matches the 13:58 sources). Tested at 1920x1080 plus a 390x844 check, with fresh contexts and seeded saves (pg_seed.js plus inline story seeds). FIXED AND VERIFIED: (1) Quest completion on catch: with 'Casting Off' seeded at 2/3, the 3rd catch shows the catch popup, the toast 'Quest complete: Casting Off | +60 gold · +40 XP · +2 Pearls' and 'Achievement unlocked: First Blood'. No TypeError. On sell: 'Quest complete: A Fair Price | +90 gold · +60 XP · +2 Pearls' plus 'Sold 1 fish'. On travel to Willow: 'Quest complete: Down the Willow | +200 gold · +90 XP · +2 Pearls'. (2) The Pearl Shop now mounts the real page (pearl-shop-page). The balance is correct. The portraits, frames and colours grids render. Buy buttons you cannot afford are disabled with the tooltip 'You need N more Pearls'. Buying Kelp Green (8 of 12 pearls) leaves 2 pearls and marks it Owned and In use, and that survives a reload. The friend-slots, rename-form and shop-walls contents are hidden. (3) 'Achievement unlocked: First Blood | +25 gold' appears on the first catch of a fresh game. badge-pin buttons exist in the DOM (2) but none are visible. (4) Contracts: a full hand-in pays out with the toast 'Contract filled for the Cook...'. It also completes the daily 'Honest Work' with its toast. A partial hand-in (1 of 5 Bluegill) moves progress to 1/5 and removes the fish from the keepnet. Accepted cards show 'due in 9h 45m'. contract-market buttons are hidden (0 visible). (5) Heaviest-catch achievements: checked in code only. stats.heaviest_kg is now updated before HB.event('catch') in land(). There was no runtime test, because a 10 kg fish is not reachable at Millbrook. Regression: fishing, sell, travel, skipping the tutorial and reload persistence all work. There were 0 /api/ calls to the app origin and 0 page errors. No horizontal overflow at 390px. NEW ISSUES: the partial hand-in toast shows the text 'undefined'. The Pearl Shop tabs for hidden content are still clickable and open empty panels. All portraits show the same placeholder image. Smaller issues are listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: After a partial delivery the toast reads 'Handed in , deliver 5× bluegill is undefined/undefined'. Contracts.js:173 reads r.data.delivered, r.data.progress and r.data.target, but the offline contractAct partial branch (harbour.js:136) only returns {done:false, state, user}. Fix: return {done:false, delivered: fish.length, progress: a.progress, target: a.qty, state, user}.

shop-tab-walls and shop-tab-friends open empty panels, because their content is hidden by CSS but the tab buttons are not. shop-tab-identity ('Name change') shows 'Change your angler name for 30...' with no form. Hide [data-testid=shop-tab-walls], [data-testid=shop-tab-friends] and [data-testid=shop-tab-identity] offline, or remove them from CATEGORIES when OFFLINE.

Every premium portrait shows the same placeholder (art/angler.png). PortraitCard uses /art/avatars/<id>.jpg, but the pgtest build has no art/avatars folder. A player can spend 10-15 pearls on a portrait that looks identical to the others. Ship art/avatars/*.jpg in the Playgama build, or hide portraits that have no art.

ui_bugs.component: Pearl Shop 'How to earn' and intro text
ui_bugs.issue: The text lists online-only sources: Legendary boss slain, Tournament podium, Toplist vote, Day-7 Harbour Chest, and 'Angler Pass ... bought on the Donate page'. The Chat colours text mentions 'global, trade and crew chat'. Offline copy should only list story, weekly quest and achievement pearls.
It still says 'Press Show on up to 3 earned badges to put them on your profile (0/3)', but the Show buttons are hidden offline.
It still says fish can be 'bought on the Market'. There is no market offline.

integration_issues.issue: Some results are thrown away. server.js cast() calls HB.event('cast') and discards quests_done and new_achievements, so the daily 'Patience' (d_cast) completes and pays with no toast. Escaped fish never call event or checkAch, so the 'escaped' achievements unlock silently on a later event. travel() returns quests_done but not new_achievements. Return ev.quests_done and ev.new_achievements from the cast result, and call checkAch on escape.

The api.js interceptor now toasts new_achievements when OFFLINE. Contracts.js:172 and Inventory.js:190 (bulk sell) toast them as well, so those paths would show 'Achievement unlocked' twice. The world catch flow showed only one toast. Remove the per-page toasts when OFFLINE, or de-dupe them with a toast id.

From code: story quest 'merchants_wager' (lvl 12, event 'list', i.e. market listing) and 'old_salts_recipe' (event 'craft') can never progress offline, and each story chapter needs the previous one. The Ledger therefore dead-ends at chapter 11 of 19. Remap or skip these objectives offline.

issues: In the 'How to earn' table the Pearls column is clipped ('2 (3 w'). The table needs wrapping or a narrower layout on mobile.

action_items: Return delivered, progress and target from the offline partial contract deliver (harbour.js:136) to fix the 'undefined/undefined' toast
Hide the Pearl Shop tabs walls, friends and identity offline
Ship the art/avatars portrait images in the Playgama build, or hide those portraits
Return quests_done and new_achievements from offline cast(); call checkAch on escape; return new_achievements from travel()
Avoid duplicate achievement toasts (api.js interceptor plus Contracts.js and Inventory.js) in the offline build
Make the 'list' and 'craft' story objectives completable offline so the Ledger does not dead-end
Clean up offline copy: Pearl sources, Donate and Angler Pass, the Market mention in the Contracts intro, the 'Press Show' text, and the chat colour description
Fix the Pearl Shop 'How to earn' table clipping at 390px
critical_code_review_comments: harbour.js newOffer sets deadline=endOf(1) at offer time, so an order accepted late in the day has only minutes left. That matches expires_at, but there is no deadline enforcement offline, so the 'due in' label is only cosmetic.
harbour.js contract deliver uses S().catches.filter(species).slice(0,left) and can hand in a fish the player wanted to keep. There is no selection or confirm.
pg_seed.js uses d.h.contracts.offers[0] as the base. Open the Contracts page before seeding, or the seeded contracts have no patron or deadline. pg_setup.py does this.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all 6 requested items pass; heaviest-catch is checked in code only; 1 new HIGH toast bug in the partial hand-in)

seed_data_creation: Local bridge storage only (fishyland_save) in throwaway browser contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: exec(open(f).read(), globals()) for pg_helpers.py, pg_harbour.py and pg_setup.py, in that order. seeded(page) runs boot -> skip tutorial -> open contracts (rolls offers) -> travel -> SEED -> reload -> installs the toast observer (window.__toasts). After a reload the player is at the harbour. Use to_millbrook(page) before fishing. Escape does not close the pages; click [data-testid=modal-close-btn]. The map Travel button is [data-testid=map-travel] (map-fish-here does not exist for non-current waters). GETSAVE gives a save summary. Today's daily includes d_contract (Honest Work). Duel Pier is not built.
